  "overall_experience": "The People Experience Manager likely found BambooHR to be a solid, reliable platform for managing essential HR functions over their two-plus years of use. While generally easy to use and effective for core tasks like leave and document management, they may have encountered some minor frustrations with recruitment features or the depth of reporting. The platform served as a valuable all-in-one solution for their small to medium-sized professional training and coaching company."
